Edit target is this four-frame transparent pixel pedestrian strip. Keep frames 1 and 2 unchanged. Keep character identity, all four heads, camera facing SOUTHWEST/lower-left, costumes, scale, pixel style, transparent background and equal 4-cell horizontal layout. Correct ONLY gait in frames 3 and 4. Currently frame 3 repeats frame 1 and frame 4 repeats frame 2. In frame 3 the FAR LEG (on screen right at the hip) must swing diagonally forward to lower-left, crossing in front of the NEAR LEG; the near leg must be visibly BEHIND with heel up toward upper-right. Counter-swing the arms opposite frame 1. Frame 4 is the opposite-leg passing pose: far leg now planted under torso, near leg bent at knee swinging through. Make an unmistakable alternating left-right walking cycle instead of repeating the same foot step. Do not turn the body or face. No new objects, labels, shadows, background or borders.
